---
description: List each query that ichnos could not read, with the first line of its error.
title: ichnos unparsed
---

`ichnos unparsed` writes one line per query that ichnos could not read whole: its name, a colon, and the first line of its error.
Every other command writes the count to stderr and leaves the list to this one, so a slice stays clean to paste.

## Usage

```{python}
#| label: help
#| echo: false
from _scripts.example import ichnos

ichnos("unparsed", "--help")
```

## Example

The synthetic corpus parses whole, so the command writes nothing.

```{python}
#| label: example
#| echo: false
from _scripts.example import ichnos

ichnos("unparsed", "queries")
```
